This name has bought guide raises hard (+44% in Aug, +7.5% in Mar), so I lean up at p_up 57. The beat is an inference that the Earnings Whispers preview already frames, and a $10M Libervant upfront paid in Q4 puts the 35% adj. EBITDA margin guide at risk, so the lean stays mild; abs_move 13 sits between the 7.5% median reaction and a 20% implied move that a 75%-of-mid spread makes only indicative.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus $42.2M and EPS $0.34-0.36. Two agreeing sources give the $42.2M revenue: Earnings Whispers preview 2026-10-29 (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ETON/22460) and Benzinga (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/ETON/earnings-forecasts). One Earnings Whispers page shows a stale $30.72M and an FY consensus of $120.2M that sits below the company guide, so aggregator FY numbers are stale. Company guide (Q2 release 2026-08-13, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001710340/000143774926027672/ex_974033.htm): FY2026 revenue at least $145M, adj. EBITDA margin at least 35%, adj. gross margin above 70%, R&D $10-14M weighted to H2. H1 revenue was $61.9M, so H2 needs at least $83.1M, about $41.5M a quarter.
positioning_check: Short interest 1.83M shares, 2.9 days to cover as of the 2026-09-30 settlement (https://massive.com/quote/eton). Equibles had 1.3M shares, 4.6% of float, 2.1 days as of 2026-08-20 and rising (https://equibles.com/stocks/eton/shortinterest). That puts it at roughly 6-7% of float: building but not crowded. Skew is null in the baseline (no 25-delta read). Put/call OI ratio is 0.21, so call-heavy positioning. Front-expiry ATM IV is 125% and the event-implied move 20.4%, but the ATM spread is 75% of mid, so the implied move is indicative only. The stock is -10% over 20 days, -23.5% from its 52-week high of $66.37 and at $49.28 sits near the $48.36 post-Q2 low. Insiders sold after Q2: director Paul Maier exercised and sold 50,000 options (~$59, 2026-08-28) and the CBO sold 4,166 shares (~$55, 2026-10-06).

findings.finding: Using the company's own Hemangeol figures (about 8,000 treated infants a year, $8,000-10,000 net per course, so roughly $16-20M a quarter at run rate), Q3 is the first full quarter after the May 1 relaunch, while Q2 carried only about two months. Q2 revenue was $37.6M against Q1's $24.3M with no Hemangeol. Adding the missing third month (about $5-7M) to base-portfolio growth and a small IMPAVIDO start implies Q3 revenue of about $43-46M against the $42.2M consensus. Q4 at a similar level would put FY2026 at about $150M+ against a guide of 'at least $145M', making a further raise (the third this year) likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide raises have been bought on this name. Q2 (2026-08-13: revenue guide >$120M to >$145M, margin guide 30% to 35%) +44.3%. Q4'25 (2026-03-19, first 2026 guide >$110M) +7.5%. Q1 (2026-05-14, raise to >$120M with an EPS miss) +1.0%. Q3'25 (2025-11-06) -11.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $42.2M is only 12% above Q2, about what one extra Hemangeol month adds with no base growth. The stock is down 24% from its post-Q2 high and back near its post-earnings low, which is not what a name pricing a beat-and-raise looks like. If the market had priced it, the stock would hold its post-Q2 level and the revenue consensus would sit nearer $44-45M. Caveat, sized in: the 2026-10-29 Earnings Whispers preview headline frames exactly this question, so part of it is visible.
findings.independence: Patient volume (~8,000/yr, could exceed 10,000) and net price ($8-10K) come from the Q2 call as reported by search summaries (marketbeat call highlights, https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/eton-pharmaceuticals-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-13/, page itself 403). The 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001710340/000143774926027684/eton20260630_10q.htm) says revenue is recognised when stock is pulled to fill patient orders through AnovoRx (90% of revenue) with no returns, which argues against a Q2 channel-stocking pull-forward. Same company documents, so not independent of the guide.

findings.finding: Eton paid Aquestive a $10.0M upfront on 2026-10-13 for U.S. LIBERVANT rights, booked as an asset acquisition of a product that has only FDA tentative approval (8-K items 1.01/2.01), with up to $47.5M in milestones and mid-teens royalties. Eton's 35% adj. EBITDA margin guide explicitly absorbed the $3M ASN-001 upfront. If the Libervant $10M is expensed as IPR&D and included the same way, FY adj. EBITDA of at least $50.75M (35% of $145M) against $21.9M in H1 needs at least $28.9M in H2 after about $17M of upfronts and the possible $4M ALKINDI milestone, so the margin guide is at risk of a cut or a carve-out. Netted against this, the deal adds a $450M seizure-rescue market for an April 2027 launch that supports the $200M end-2027 run-rate target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The adj. EBITDA margin guide was raised in Aug (+44% day, alongside the revenue raise). No prior instance of a margin-guide cut on this name in the baseline.
findings.why_not_priced: The deal was announced on 2026-10-14 with no stated accounting treatment or guidance impact, and no preview found discusses its effect on the 35% margin guide. If it were priced, a preview would carry an EBITDA consensus below 35% or the stock would have reacted to the 8-K. The accounting is my inference (tentative approval implies an IPR&D expense, but it could be capitalised), and the market may look through a BD-driven margin change, so the size is small and nets the strategic positive.
findings.independence: Aquestive's own 8-K and Q3 release confirm the $10M upfront (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001398733/000139873326000056/aqst-20261013.htm); that confirms the payment, not the accounting.

findings.finding: Eton still carries a 100% valuation allowance (about $22M per the Earnings Whispers preview) against its deferred tax assets as of 2026-06-30, while H1 2026 net income was $13.1M. A release once cumulative profitability is established would add roughly $0.6-0.8 to GAAP EPS against a $0.34 consensus: a headline-EPS beat with no operating content.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior tax-allowance event for this name. The Q1 2026 EPS miss saw +1.0%, so this name's EPS headline matters less than its revenue guide.
findings.why_not_priced: EPS consensus ($0.34-0.36) carries no release. Timing is uncertain (many companies release in Q4), and it is below operating income with no path to guidance, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: The Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-10-29 flags the ~$22M allowance (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ETON/22460).

findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the company guided the $3M expense and the R&D ramp, and consensus EPS already reflects it. Filed because a lumpy ex-U.S. quarter could dent the margin headline.
